name: Microsoft Teams
description: Teams chats and meetings: read chats, send messages, schedule online meetings.
help: FASTEST: paste the Application (client) ID below, press Connect and approve in the browser. ALTERNATIVE: use teams_connect_start, open the shown link and enter the code, then teams_connect_finish. Register the app once at portal.azure.com > App registrations (multitenant, public client flows allowed, delegated: User.Read, Chat.ReadWrite, Chat.Create, OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite, offline_access). The sign-in is remembered and refreshes itself.

fields.label: Client secret (only for confidential apps, blank for public clients)
Refresh token (filled in automatically by connect)
